suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

before_times: the child's first name and age (the birth date only on the secure page)
a current patient or a new family
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the child will be in
after_time: anything the office should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the parent's or guardian's name and mobile
secure_page_only: how the person booking is related to the child
the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the health history and changes since the last visit

intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, reasons or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian, or an adult the family's record names; either parent may, unless the office holds a court order that limits it (Rosie follows the record, never the caller's word alone); a teen alone only for the visit types the office marks private, where the state's rules let a minor consent (a switch); a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
intake_questions.who_may_bring: a switch: a parent or legal guardian brings the child; another adult (a grandparent, a sitter) only with the parent's signed OK on the secure page; the office may ask for a parent at a first visit, or where the state's rules require one

stop.words: trouble breathing, won't wake up, blue lips, or a seizure
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the child isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: a sick child with nothing on the lists above
go_on.what: matched to the office's own sick visit; Rosie never judges how sick a child is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, changes since the last visit, the vaccine record and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before check-in); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new family; current patients before each well-child visit
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the front desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every family that names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the family may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay families
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A new family's records from the last doctor
steps.when: asked for on the secure page; the office gets them, office to office
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them

steps.name: Sam's OK for a new family
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card, and the vaccine record if it isn't on file; a parent or guardian comes with the child, or an adult the parent named with a signed OK; at home: the baby's last weight from the hospital, if you have it

staff.skills: pediatricians and nurse practitioners: well-child visits, sick visits, new families, video visits and newborn home visits; nurses: flu shots and shot-only visits on the clinician's order; the lactation consultant: breastfeeding help; only people cleared for home visits go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each pediatrician's, nurse practitioner's, physician assistant's and nurse's own license, per state
staff.supervision: a nurse practitioner or physician assistant works within the state's rules for supervision or a collaboration agreement (a switch from the state's form)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a new family's first visit, same-day times for a new family, and anything a nurse flags
staff.stand_in: a pediatrician out: the nurse practitioner may take the visit, with the parent's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or legal guardian, or an adult the family's record names; either parent may, unless the office holds a court order that limits it (Rosie follows the record, never the caller's word alone); a teen alone only for the visit types the office marks private, where the state's rules let a minor consent (a switch); a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent or guardian; a teen's private visit is texted only to the teen's own phone, with no visit type, and never shows on a parent's list or in the family's texts; a child under 13 never texts Rosie, and nothing about them is kept
children_and_age.minors_rules: who may consent for a child, which visit types a teen may book alone, and from what age (a switch from the state form)

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk, and the desk checks the adult is the parent or guardian, or the adult the parent named; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the parent at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, results and vaccine record stay in the office's own records, never in Rosie or a text; the next well-child visit is booked at checkout
visit.changes_at_visit: the clinician picks the shots due at the visit, from the child's age and record; a test is added only with the parent's yes, with any self-pay price first; more care is booked as its own visit only if the parent asks
visit.before_work: the nurse checks the child's weight and height and the changes since the last visit, before the exam

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each pediatrician (MD or DO), nurse practitioner, physician assistant and nurse holds their own active license from the state where the child is during the visit; which roles need which license comes from the state's form (a switch)
license.who: each person; the practice too where the state's form registers medical offices or their owners
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the practice's registration number from the owner
license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, shots, results or the clinician's name (at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the family needs an interpreter, and the office is told
